svg.title: Generation throughput in default chat on M4
svg.desc: Guffin and llama.cpp core chat throughput with zero-based bars. Gemma 2 default: 16.76 vs 13.63 tokens/s; Gemma 3 ordinary: 12.57 vs 12.40; speculative defaults: 18.43 vs 8.43. One pass, 32 conversations per engine.

cc:Work.dc:title: Generation throughput in default chat on MacBook Air M4
cc:Work.dc:description: Core suite only: 32 conversations and 64 turns per engine. Guffin/llama.cpp generation tokens per second: Gemma 2 default 16.76/13.63; Gemma 3 ordinary 12.57/12.40; Gemma 3 speculative defaults 18.43/8.43. Rates sum N-1 generation steps and first-to-last selection durations. Raw data and settings: benchmarks/results/gemma2-release-v2, gemma3-normal-release-v2, gemma3-speculative-release. Different sampled answers; single pass; no uncertainty estimate.
